name: Importance-Driven Visualization Model
definition: A visualization framework that dynamically adjusts visual representation based on computed feature importance to resolve occlusion and maximize perceptible information. It replaces viewpoint-independent classification with a pipeline of importance specification, compositing, and sparseness representation.
summary: The Importance-Driven Visualization Model resolves occlusion by decoupling feature visibility from scalar values, suppressing less important structures to guide viewer attention to salient regions.
